title: A Banquet with Jesus
historical_source: Babylonian Talmud, Shabbat fol. 153a; R. Yohanan b. Zakkai banquet comparison

source_content.luke_14_15_24: The great supper and the excuses of those invited; the poor, maimed, halt, blind, and those from highways and hedges are brought in.
source_content.deuteronomy_20_5_9: Exemptions from battle involving a new house, vineyard, betrothed wife, and the fearful/fainthearted.
source_content.rabbinic_parallel: A king invites courtiers to a banquet without setting a time; the prepared are welcomed while the unprepared are rebuked.

legacy_source.content_preservation: Original legacy sermon/source document preserved unchanged.

brl_import.notes: Imported as sermon 4 in the BRL-SER-411.xxx Josh Hetrick Legacy Sermon collection. Metadata reflects only material present in the legacy source.
